content: Chatwoot POST /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages accepts content, message_type (outgoing/incoming), private, content_type, content_attributes, campaign_id, template_params, attachments[]. Auth via api_access_token header (user API key or agent bot key). template_params = {name, category (UTILITY/MARKETING/SHIPPING_UPDATE/TICKET_UPDATE/ISSUE_RESOLUTION), language (BCP47), content_mode, processed_params}. NO rate limits documented in Chatwoot API reference — self-hosted limits come from the underlying WhatsApp provider, not Chatwoot. Known bug: templates with required HEADER named params fail with Meta error #132000 because Chatwoot sends empty processed_params (chatwoot issue #13851). Chatwoot supports Meta Cloud API, Twilio, and 360dialog as WhatsApp providers; unofficial Baileys/Z-API only via community forks (fazer.ai) or Evolution API bridge. Sending requires an EXISTING conversation_id — there is no plain 'send to arbitrary number' endpoint.
